product_metadata.title: Oggi Sugar Canister, 5 x 7.5 / 62oz, Stainless Steel
features: DURABLE & CONTEMPORARY: These stylish, large 62 fluid ounces, airtight sugar storage containers made from durable steel will enhance your kitchen space and fit with both modern and traditional decor.
AIRTIGHT & SEE-THRU LIDS: Clear lids enable you to see the sugar which is kept fresh and dry due to the silicone gaskets and locking clamps.
SLEEK ON YOUR COUNTER: These stylish sugar canisters are great looking and will enhance your countertops. Place them with your matching tea and coffee canisters for a serious, coordinated, look.

PREMIUM MATERIALS: OGGI Stainless Steel Sugar Canisters are crafted from food grade stainless steel and the clear lids are BPA free with a long-lasting silicone seal to keep your favorite sugar fresh.
EASY CARE: These durable metal containers require minimal cleaning: wipe each stainless steel airtight container clean with a damp cloth between uses.
description: On the kitchen counter, in the cupboard or pantry; wherever you need a sugar container for bulk sugar, sugar for coffee, superfine or powdered sugar, pure cane sugar, crystal sugar and brown sugar. OGGI's Stainless Steel Sugar Container makes an ideal airtight container for all types of sugar. With an elegant "Sugar" label it is an easy to find and practical sugar container. These brushed stainless airtight sugar canisters have a silicone lined, airtight, see-thru clamp lid to keep moisture out and freshness in. The sleek OGGI airtight sugar container is lighter than glass and more durable too! Its capacity is 62 fluid ounces, 1.94 quarts, 7.64 cups.
